record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: constant-function characterization using liminf nonlocal tails
record.original_question: Let Omega be a smooth bounded connected domain in R^N, and for lambda > 0, p >= 1, and measurable u: Omega -> R, let Phi_{lambda,p}(u) be the measure of pairs (x,y) in Omega x Omega for which |u(x)-u(y)|^p / |x-y|^{p+N} >= lambda. If liminf_{lambda->infinity} lambda Phi_{lambda,p}(u)=0 for some p >= 1, must u be almost everywhere constant?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 9.1 ([33, Open Problem 1]). Assume that u satisfies lim inf_{lambda->infinity} lambda Phi_{lambda,p}(u) = 0 for some p >= 1. Can one conclude that u is a constant?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^N$ be a smooth bounded connected domain. For a measurable function $u:\Omega \to \mathbb{R}$, a real number $p \ge 1$, and $\lambda > 0$, define
$$\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u) \;=\; \mathcal{L}^{2N}\!\left(\Big\{ (x,y)\in \Omega\times\Omega : \frac{|u(x)-u(y)|^{p}}{|x-y|^{p+N}} \ge \lambda \Big\}\right),$$
where $\mathcal{L}^{2N}$ denotes Lebesgue measure on $\mathbb{R}^{2N}$.

Suppose that for some $p \ge 1$,
$$\liminf_{\lambda \to \infty} \lambda\, \Phi_{\lambda,p}(u) \;=\; 0.$$
Must $u$ be almost everywhere constant on $\Omega$?
artifact.category_tag: Sobolev space characterizations via nonlocal functionals
artifact.status_search_result: The question, posed in the context of nonlocal characterizations of Sobolev/BV norms studied by Brezis, Van Schaftingen, Yung, Seeger, and Nguyen, is listed as an open problem. Recent surveys and 2024–2025 papers on these functionals state related open questions but do not report a resolution; partial negative results exist in different parameter regimes (e.g., for related quantities with $\gamma<0$) but do not settle the constancy question for $\liminf_{\lambda\to\infty}\lambda\,\Phi_{\lambda,p}(u)=0$.

status_evidence.title: Characterizations of the Sobolev norms and the total variation via nonlocal functionals, and related problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open questions on whether liminf/limsup of Phi_lambda controls the Sobolev seminorm; related questions remain unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related questions on the functionals Phi_{lambda,p} are stated as open.

status_evidence.title: Some of my favorite open problems (Brezis)
status_evidence.snippet: List of open problems in nonlinear analysis including questions on nonlocal functionals characterizing constants and Sobolev spaces.
status_evidence.claim: The constancy problem for liminf lambda Phi_{lambda,p}(u)=0 is listed as an open problem.
